recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-3543; future accession-number modeling changes should use a new ImagingStudy tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-3543 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core ImagingStudy change request from the initial draft asking to rename accessionNo to accession for DSTU1.
initial_application: Historical commit e621d20623aabcc8c4ceddf6fc115cc185c914c0 explicitly cites #3543 and changed ImagingStudy.accessionNo to ImagingStudy.accession in the then-current imagingstudy spreadsheet and search parameter mapping.
additional_context: ImagingStudy is active in source/fhir.ini. The old spreadsheet source is no longer present in the current resource folder; current ImagingStudy source has no ImagingStudy.accessionNo element or ImagingStudy.accession path. Later ImagingStudy work models accession number through ImagingStudy.basedOn Reference.identifier using ACSN, and FHIR-56033 removed inconsistent accession-number wording from ImagingStudy.identifier.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active source already avoids the obsolete accessionNo name and contains current accession-number guidance in basedOn/Reference.identifier notes.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied R6 ImagingStudy clarification removed inconsistent accession-number guidance under ImagingStudy.identifier and supports the current basedOn/Reference.identifier modeling.
